status: Local source repair validated; publication pending
area: Natural-language task intent / content path inference
finding: The deterministic task reference matcher extracted numbered identifiers from arbitrary content paths. A real newsletter request naming content/issue-001.json was interpreted as ISSUE-001 and TASK-ISSUE-001, then failed with ATM_NEXT_TASK_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND before ordinary governed work could begin. Shorthand range and uppercase task-family matchers could infer the same false authority from adjacent path forms.
expectedBehavior: Apply one path-context boundary to inferred task IDs, shorthand ranges, direct roots, and family roots. Arbitrary file and URL tokens must not manufacture task identifiers. Preserve standalone identifiers, explicit CLI selections, task ranges, task-card basenames, task Markdown files under tasks directories, and ATM task ledger references. Unknown explicit task selections must remain fail-closed.
evidenceOrRepro: tests/cli/next-task-hint-paths.test.ts first failed on content/issue-001.json against the original matcher. The repaired matcher passes the exact newsletter prompt, relative and Windows paths, arbitrary content URLs, uppercase family names, path-shaped ranges, explicit task aliases, slash/comma ranges, recognized task-card and ledger paths, real task selection, and unknown explicit-task rejection. Independent review added a red-to-green test for task-card line locators; recognized task-card URLs and line references remain usable while content-file locators remain excluded. The regression is registered in scripts/validate-cli/focused-regressions.ts. The standard fast CLI validator, typecheck, targeted lint, encoding, generated-projection validation, and existing journaling, explicit-running-task, route-hydration, continuation, planning-root, dependency, and external-scan regressions pass. The relevant source matched remote main after PR #148 before editing.
followUp: Keep local source repair distinct from frozen-runner publication, a new npm release, and fresh installed acceptance. Rebuild and verify the unchanged natural-language newsletter request against an authorized source-built package before making an installation success claim. Content paths may still participate in ordinary scope matching; this repair only prevents their identifier-like substrings from becoming inferred task references.
